buildings.name: Gaspiritamon, Rune-Wolf Valkyrie #1
buildings.dialogue: GASPIRITAMON (Mega · Data): "A frost-clad runic knight wielding a glowing hammer and round shield beside an ethereal wolf forged from glacial spirit flames." Jurus Khas: Fenrir Maelstrom.

buildings.name: Mastenamon, Fallen & Holy Seraph #1
buildings.dialogue: MASTENAMON (Mega · Vaccine): "An archangelic fusion knight uniting twelve asymmetric wings of radiant alabaster and obsidian darkness, opening dimensional rifts to banish chaos." Jurus Khas: Chaos Degradation & Dark Despair.

buildings.name: Shogun Alphamon, Onyx Steed Samurai #1
buildings.dialogue: SHOGUN ALPHAMON (Ultra · Vaccine): "A samurai warlord riding an armored ebony warhorse with blazing hooves, bearing dual battle standards and a golden naginata." Jurus Khas: Crimson Naginata Charge.

buildings.name: Holloknightmon, Sun-Winged Arbiter #1
buildings.dialogue: HOLLOKNIGHTMON (Mega · Vaccine): "An ivory four-armed paladin crowned with solar spokes and glowing amber wings, delivering judgment with a silver greatsword." Jurus Khas: Radiance Decree.

buildings.name: Ragnaloardmon, Legend-Arms Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: RAGNALOARDMON (Ultra · Virus): "The Legend-Arms fusion knight cloaked in living inferno flames, wielding both the golden sword Durandamon and red dragon shield Bryweludramon." Jurus Khas: Direct Smasher.

buildings.name: Jesmon (X Antibody), Judgment Blade #1
buildings.dialogue: JESMON X (Ultra · Data): "An unbreakable Royal Knight awakened by the X-Antibody, sheathing itself in crimson and chrome blades that strike before malice can act." Jurus Khas: Tekken Seibai.

buildings.name: Mastemon, Jogress of Light & Shadow #1
buildings.dialogue: MASTEMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A transcendent angel forged by uniting holy light and fallen darkness, opening portals between dimensions with twelve asymmetric wings." Jurus Khas: Chaos Degradation.

buildings.name: Plusiamon, Twin-Armored Mecha Dragon #1
buildings.dialogue: PLUSIAMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A heavily armed cyborg dragon knight soaring on twin gold-rimmed wing binders, pairing a glowing cyan plasma cannon and energy blade with an inferno shoulder launcher." Jurus Khas: Plasma Cannon & Thruster Flare.

buildings.name: Mazagamon, Violet Calamity Beast #1
buildings.dialogue: MAZAGAMON (Mega · Virus): "A horned abyssal titan whose chrome gauntlets crackle with dark violet lightning while crimson armor fins erupt down its spine." Jurus Khas: Abyssal Volt Overload.

buildings.name: Plusiamon, Twin-Armored Mecha Dragon #1
buildings.dialogue: PLUSIAMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A heavily armed cyborg dragon knight soaring on twin gold-rimmed wing binders, pairing a glowing cyan plasma cannon and energy blade with an inferno shoulder launcher." Jurus Khas: Plasma Cannon & Thruster Flare.

buildings.name: Malgadramon, Cyber-Bone Reaver #1
buildings.dialogue: MALGADRAMON (Mega · Virus): "A biomechanical skull-beast fused with heavy hydraulic cables and an over-shoulder railgun built to tear through citadel gates." Jurus Khas: Bio-Rail Laceration.

buildings.name: VictoryGrowlmon, Crimson Dramon Knight #1
buildings.dialogue: VICTORYGROWLMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A fierce scarlet dragon warrior equipped with twin jet cannons, a chrome lance gauntlet, and a golden-edged shield blade." Jurus Khas: Dramon Victory Slash.

buildings.name: Vexatiamon Berserker, Dual-Cannon Drake #1
buildings.dialogue: VEXATIAMON: B (Mega · Virus): "A horned violet-winged dragon mounting dual jaw cannons on its shoulders that detonate solar plasma spheres at point-blank range." Jurus Khas: Hyper Rail Salvo.

buildings.name: Karatiamon, Nocturne Rune Fang #1
buildings.dialogue: KARATIAMON (Ultimate · Virus): "A winged wolf swordsman cloaked in midnight tatters, swinging a rune-carved broadsword while phantom violet flames engulf its paw." Jurus Khas: Violet Hex Blade.

buildings.name: Sakuyamon (X Antibody), Silver Fox Shrine #1
buildings.dialogue: SAKUYAMON X (Mega · Data): "A mystic shrine maiden riding an ethereal frost-blue kitsune wolf, conjuring dark spirit foxes and sacred golden rune ribbons." Jurus Khas: Izuna Amaterasu.

buildings.name: Gammamon, Heavy Panzer Dino #1
buildings.dialogue: GAMMAMON (Ultimate · Data): "A riveted steel sauropod venting turbine exhaust from six dorsal pipes and sweeping rivals with an axe-tipped armored tail." Jurus Khas: Steam-Stack Cannon.

buildings.name: Megidramon (X Antibody), Hellfire Seraph #1
buildings.dialogue: MEGIDRAMON X (Ultra · Virus): "A calamitous dragon crowned with cerulean hazard flames, unfurling solar-fire wings above a coiled magma serpent body." Jurus Khas: Hell Howling Blaze.

buildings.name: Belphemon (X Antibody), Wrath Demon Lord #1
buildings.dialogue: BELPHEMON X (Ultra · Virus): "The Demon Lord of Sloth mutated by the X-Antibody, tearing the horizon with chained horns and blazing magenta gauntlet claws." Jurus Khas: Seventh Full Cluster.

buildings.name: Fivedramon, Five-Chromatic Drake #1
buildings.dialogue: FIVEDRAMON (Ultra · Virus): "A colossal armored dragon bearing five prismatic heads and elemental breath, unleashing devastation across sky and earth." Jurus Khas: Grand Cross Breaker.

buildings.name: NeoTitamon, Venomous War Titan #1
buildings.dialogue: NEOTITAMON (Mega · Virus): "An evolved warlord clad in spiked skull pauldrons, smashing through steel fortifications with a venomous battle axe." Jurus Khas: Toxic Soul Shatter.

buildings.name: Vamdramon, Abyssal Dread Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: VAMDRAMON (Ultimate · Virus): "A nocturnal dragon-lord draped in a torn scarlet mantle, spreading violet wing-fins and obsidian claws through twilight ruins." Jurus Khas: Crimson Nocturne.

buildings.name: Titamon Berserker, Bone-Cleave Ogre #1
buildings.dialogue: TITAMON: B (Mega · Virus): "A rage-consumed warlord brandishing a jagged colossal bone cleaver while violet battle spirit erupts across its horned armor." Jurus Khas: Phantom Pain Cleave.

buildings.name: HazardGrowlmon, Volatile Core Wyvern #1
buildings.dialogue: HAZARDGROWLMON (Ultimate · Virus): "An unstable crimson cyborg wyvern venting hazard plasma from dorsal thrusters while sweeping targets with twin forearm blades." Jurus Khas: Digital Hazard Core.

buildings.name: Ignisdramon, Blazing Jet Dragon Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: IGNISDRAMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A cybernetic Dragon Warrior clad in black-and-white Chrome Digizoid armor with hot-rod flame decals. Soars with twin shoulder jet turbines and sweeps the field with a double-ended scythe-spear." Jurus Khas: Crimson Flare Scythe & Turbo Positron Lance.

buildings.name: Nezhamon, Multi-Armed Fiery Biker Warrior #1
buildings.dialogue: NEZHAMON (Mega · Data): "A six-armed warrior roaring across the road astride a flame-wheeled cyberbike, wielding twin fire blades, ice spear, and chain flail." Jurus Khas: Lotus Turbo Wheel & Blazing Sabers.

buildings.name: Shoutmon EX6, Golden Winged Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: SHOUTMON EX6 (Ultra · Data): "A six-winged armored champion forged from united Digimon wills, gripping a radiant greatsword and plasma cannon." Jurus Khas: Meteor Buster & Six-Wing Judgement.

buildings.name: Titamon + SkullBaluchimon, Bone Titan #1
buildings.dialogue: TITAMON & SKULLB. (Ultra · Virus): "The furious Titan commander riding the winged mechanical bone-steed SkullBaluchimon with the colossal Soul Chopper blade." Jurus Khas: Soul Chopper & Abyssal Trample.

buildings.name: Fanglongmon: Ruin Mode, Abyssal Wyrm #1
buildings.dialogue: FANGLONGMON RM (Ultra · Virus): "The primordial Earth Sovereign Dragon tainted by dark ruin flames, crowned by four hovering azure spirit fires." Jurus Khas: Taiji Ruin & Blue Soul Orbs.

buildings.name: Vortexdramon, Azure Tempest Wyrm #1
buildings.dialogue: VORTEXDRAMON (Mega · Data): "A sleek winged sea-sky dragon surfing high-altitude winds with iridescent crystal pinions and coiled storm tail." Jurus Khas: Cyclone Lance & Prism Gales.

buildings.name: Amaterasumon, Solar Radiance Sovereign #1
buildings.dialogue: AMATERASUMON (Ultra · Vaccine): "A celestial sun goddess framed by twin golden wing-fans bearing sacred balance crests and radiant halos." Jurus Khas: Heavenly Mirror of Dawn.

buildings.name: Kentaurosmon (X-Antibody), Radiant Bow #1
buildings.dialogue: KENTAUROSMON X (Mega · Vaccine): "An evolved Sleipmon clad in scarlet draconic barding drawing an incandescent holy star-bow across the battlefield." Jurus Khas: Bifrost & Odin’s Breath.

buildings.name: Examon (X-Antibody), Dragon Emperor #1
buildings.dialogue: EXAMON X (Ultra · Data): "The supreme Dragon Emperor Royal Knight empowered by the X-Antibody, commanding radiant emerald energy lances." Jurus Khas: Pendragon’s Glory & Ambrosius Blade.

buildings.name: Kazuchimon, Emerald Lightning Shogun #1
buildings.dialogue: KAZUCHIMON (Mega · Vaccine): "A storm-forged warrior wrapped in sacred shimenawa ropes wielding twin emerald plasma katanas." Jurus Khas: Mighty Thunder Strike.

buildings.name: HeavyMetaldramon, Sonic Abyss Wyrm #1
buildings.dialogue: HEAVYMETALDRAMON (Mega · Virus): "A serpentine cybernetic dragon sporting crystalline distortion wings and sub-zero bass-cannon shockwaves." Jurus Khas: Flying Destruction & Hellfire Chord.

buildings.name: Gaiomon: Itto Mode, Crimson Ronin #1
buildings.dialogue: GAIOMON ITTO (Mega · Virus): "A master draconic samurai clad in lacquered crimson armor wielding a colossal serrated war-blade." Jurus Khas: Kikurin & Crimson Greatsword.

buildings.name: GraceNovamon, Galactic Nova Colossus #1
buildings.dialogue: GRACENOVAMON (Ultra · Vaccine): "Jogress of Apollomon and Dianamon whose flowing cloak contains spinning nebulae and solar-lunar gauntlets." Jurus Khas: Caloris Tempest & Finger of Dawn.

buildings.name: Bryweludramon, Scarlet Shield Dragon #1
buildings.dialogue: BRYWELUDRAMON (Mega · Data): "An impenetrable red-armored fortress dragon bearing twin towering Chrome Digizoid shields and blue solar flames." Jurus Khas: Red Flare & Blast Shield.

buildings.name: Jupitermon: Wrath Mode, Thunder King #1
buildings.dialogue: JUPITERMON WM (Ultra · Vaccine): "Leader of the Olympos XII engulfed in golden lightning bolts, gripping a colossal thunder-forged greatsword." Jurus Khas: Wide Plasment & Thunder Sword.

buildings.name: Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi #1
buildings.dialogue: FENRILOOGAMON T. (Ultra · Virus): "A mythical azure flame wolf-knight gripping the sacred thunder sword Takemikazuchi in its jaws." Jurus Khas: Ragnarok & Lightning Blade Takemikazuchi.

buildings.name: Craniamon + Enbarrmon, Dullahan Cavalry #1
buildings.dialogue: CRANIAMON STEED (Ultra · Vaccine): "Craniamon mounted atop the ghostly armored steed Enbarrmon, charging through castle lists with an enormous tilting lance." Jurus Khas: Spectral Lance Charge.

buildings.name: Craniamon (X-Antibody), Soul Guard #1
buildings.dialogue: CRANIAMON X (Mega · Vaccine): "An X-Antibody Royal Knight clad in violet skeletal armor wielding the twin-headed spear Claíomh Solais." Jurus Khas: End Waltz & Avalon Barrier.

buildings.name: Omnimon Alter-B, Black Eclipse Knight #1
buildings.dialogue: OMNIMON ALTER-B (Ultra · Virus): "A dark fusion of BlitzGreymon and CresGarurumon coated in obsidian alloy, reversing sword and cannon configurations." Jurus Khas: Grey Cannon & Garuru Sword.

buildings.name: Omnimon Zwart Defeat, Ruin Knight #1
buildings.dialogue: OMNIMON ZWART D (Ultra · Virus): "A shattered berserk form of Omnimon Zwart weeping dark crimson energy from cracked black Digizoid armor and tattered mantle." Jurus Khas: Supreme Cannon & Runic Greatsword.

buildings.name: Regulusmon, Dark Dragon Scourge #1
buildings.dialogue: REGULUSMON (Mega · Virus): "A ruthless dragon warrior cloaked in pitch-black wings and a spiked shield arm radiating corrupted magenta aura." Jurus Khas: Caldead & Grantres.
